annotations.text:
Three things, one pill.
The glyph colour is which thing (Type, Refine, Ask); the ring colour is what Flow is doing (hearing, CLI, wrong). Tap cycles the mode, hold talks, right-click is the only menu.
A panel never replaces the pill: it rises above it and the pill becomes its foot, still holdable.
Refine and Ask are the same 400px panel over the same pill. What differs is where the text lands: your other window, or back to you.
